question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.**

The company of friends made her feel ________ (**cranky**), as she was all alone in her apartment.
solution: The correct answer is **"cheerful."**** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word** 'cranky' **means irritable or easily annoyed. (विचित्र; सनकी) • **Example**: *As children, we did not know that his **cranky**__ ideas could be dangerous.* • The antonym of **'cranky'** is** 'cheerful.'** • "Cheerful"** means happy and optimistic. (प्रसन्‍न, प्रमुदित; हँसमुख) __ • **Example**: *Bhavna is always very **cheerful**__.* • The company of friends made the person feel cheerful, which is the opposite of feeling cranky. • Grammatically,** 'cheerful'** is an adjective that describes the person's mood. • The correct answer is Option 3. ​ **Correct sentence**: *The company of friends made her feel __**cheerful**__, as she was all alone in her apartment.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 (awful) **means very bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा, अत्‍यधिक अरुचिकर) • **Option 2 (wishful)** means having or expressing a desire or hope for something to happen. (किसी चीज़ के घटित होने की इच्छा या आशा रखना या व्यक्त करना) • **Option 4 (fearful) **means feeling afraid or anxious. (भयभीत या चिंतित) 2f:Tb41, The correct answer is **"Interesting."**
